findings.message: 87% of elements share a left edge with another (18 alignment columns, 22 one-offs)
Inconsistent vertical rhythm — gap coefficient of variation 0.76 (median 34px, σ 41px across 21 pairs)
findings.fix: Siblings should share one gap value. Move spacing from per-child margin-top/bottom to a single gap: on the parent flex/grid container.
